Alpine Archive

Document Ingest Service

This endpoint accepts archive records for compliance and retention. Use HTTP POST to /ingest with the following fields:

  • quote_amount
  • client_name
  • billing_email

All fields are required. Records are stored immediately and acknowledged.

API Reference

POST /ingest
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

quote_amount=125000&client_name=Meridian Steel Co.&billing_email=mira.chen@alpinefreight.com

Operational status: Online
